Chat completion whose reply content is a list of text parts

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "liter_llm"
api_key = ENV.fetch("API_KEY")
client = LiterLlm.create_client(api_key)
result = client.chat_async(LiterLlm::ChatCompletionRequest.new(messages: [{ 'content' => 'Say hello world', 'role' => 'user' }], model: 'gpt-4'))
puts result.inspect
```
